name: Rolex Submariner Date
description: The definitive dive watch. Water-resistant to 300 metres, with a ceramic bezel and the celebrated calibre 3235 movement.

name: Rolex Datejust 36
description: A timeless classic with the signature fluted bezel and Jubilee bracelet. Understated elegance for every occasion.

name: Omega Speedmaster Professional
description: The Moonwatch. Flown on every crewed NASA mission since 1965. A manual-wind chronograph with unmatched heritage.

name: Omega Seamaster Aqua Terra
description: Refined and versatile. The teak-pattern dial and Co-Axial movement make it equally at home in the boardroom or on the water.

name: TAG Heuer Carrera Chronograph
description: A racing icon since 1963. Clean dial, precise chronograph, and a motor-sport spirit in every detail.

name: TAG Heuer Aquaracer
description: Sport-luxury at its finest. Water-resistant to 300 metres with a bold, angular case and luminous markers.

name: Breitling Navitimer B01
description: The pilot's chronograph. Slide-rule bezel, in-house movement, and a history tied to aviation since 1952.

name: Cartier Santos Dumont
description: A legend born in 1904. Square case, exposed screws, and pure Parisian elegance in every line.

name: IWC Portugieser Chronograph
description: A restrained masterpiece. Clean dial, in-house chronograph, and quiet confidence on the wrist.

name: Omega Constellation
description: Elegant, precise, and instantly recognisable. The claws on the bezel and integrated bracelet are unmistakable.

name: Vintage Omega Seamaster 1962
description: A mid-century classic. Restored and serviced, with a warm patina that only six decades can create.

name: Vintage Rolex Oyster Perpetual 1970
description: Seventies Rolex at its best. Understated dial, smooth bezel, and a movement that has never skipped a beat.

name: Vintage Longines Flagship 1968
description: Elegant, slim, and rare. A beautifully preserved piece from the golden age of Swiss watchmaking.

name: Vintage Seiko 5 Sports 1975
description: A Japanese icon. Automatic movement, day-date display, and rugged reliability that defined a generation.

name: Vintage Bulova Accutron 1971
description: The tuning fork revolution. Known for its smooth-sweeping seconds hand and space-age engineering.

name: Vintage Citizen Automatic 1978
description: A slim, understated ladies' automatic from the late seventies. Delicate on the wrist, dependable in hand.

name: Vintage Tissot Seastar 1973
description: A diver from the era when dive watches meant business. Chunky, confident, and ready for another fifty years.

name: Vintage Omega De Ville 1969
description: Refined and feminine. A slim gold-plated case with a textured dial that catches the light beautifully.

name: Vintage Longines Conquest 1966
description: A rare reference with a bold dial. Serviced, authenticated, and ready for daily wear.

name: Vintage Seiko Chronograph 1979
description: Japan's answer to the racing chronograph. Clean layout, reliable movement, and a growing collector following.

name: Apple Watch Series 9
description: The most popular smartwatch on the planet. Health tracking, fitness, notifications, and seamless iPhone integration.

name: Apple Watch Ultra 2
description: Built for extremes. Titanium case, dive computer, and dual-frequency GPS. The most rugged Apple Watch yet.

name: Samsung Galaxy Watch 6
description: Sleek, light, and packed with health features. Sleep tracking, ECG, and full Android integration.

name: Samsung Galaxy Watch 6 Classic
description: The rotating bezel returns. Classic watch design with modern smartwatch capability inside.

name: Garmin Fenix 7 Pro
description: The serious athlete's watch. Solar charging, multi-band GPS, and battery life measured in weeks, not days.

name: Garmin Venu 3
description: Slim, elegant, and health-focused. AMOLED display, sleep coaching, and a body-battery metric that actually helps.

name: Fitbit Sense 2
description: Stress management and sleep tracking at their best. A calm, health-first take on the smartwatch.

name: Google Pixel Watch 2
description: Google's vision of the smartwatch. Clean Wear OS, Fitbit health integration, and a smooth, minimalist design.

name: Huawei Watch GT 4
description: Elegant, lightweight, and with outstanding battery life. A smartwatch that doesn't look like a smartwatch.

name: Samsung Galaxy Watch 5
description: The previous generation, still excellent. Great value for anyone entering the smartwatch world.
